items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: I remember Joe talking about Benny you know... when I was on the band I was on there twice. And the first time it was his band and I was hired in the section

ctx.x: Okay you don’t get away with just a yes now.

Yeah all of them had — I think the biggest idiot that I ever worked for and one of the most difficult people, and I’m not the only person who would tell you this, this has been written up in books, was Benny Goodman. He was an extremely difficult person, I think even his daughter I remember in an interview, never understood her father. He was like I don’t know, in those days we didn’t know what the term “bipolar” meant you know. It was not a term that was around. I would guess almost that Benny had some bipolar…
Buddy was such a — nicest cat in the world and a great player. Why is Benny treating him like that? I thought God this is insane.
